headline: ThinkRail Turns Coding Agents Into a Workbench
lede: ThinkRail gives autonomous coding agents an architected place to work: isolated Git worktrees, durable specifications, parallel sessions, and reviewable merges. Its desktop and browser interfaces keep agent execution tied to the familiar discipline of branches, tests, pull requests, and CI.

headline: Portable Design Rules for Coding Agents
lede: AI Design Skills collects reusable instructions for turning plain-language briefs into deliberate interfaces. Each markdown-based skill packages requirements, structure, typography, spacing, motion, and conversion guidance that teams can carry across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and Cline.

headline: Superpowers Makes Agentic Coding Methodical
lede: Superpowers places requirements discovery, validated design, test-driven development, and review ahead of code generation. Its composable skills and worktree-based workflow give coding agents a repeatable operating procedure across today’s major agent environments.

headline: DeepTutor Builds a Personal Learning Graph
lede: DeepTutor routes a learner’s books, documents, repositories, videos, and web sources through retrieval and indexing systems including GraphRAG, FAISS, and PageIndex. Citations, adaptive practice, mastery paths, and progress memory turn scattered material into a connected study pipeline.

headline: Macro Connects Work Across the Company
lede: Macro consolidates mail, messaging, documents, tasks, CRM, calls, files, and pull requests in one searchable workspace. Its bidirectional links and shared permissions let people and agents carry context from a conversation to the work it creates.

headline: Hallmark Gives AI-Built Pages a Visual Standard
lede: Hallmark directs coding agents through themes, real photography, focused hero reviews, and browser checks across eight viewport widths. It treats accessibility, responsive behavior, reduced motion, factual accuracy, and preserved wiring as part of the design—not cleanup after it.

headline: Impeccable Audits the AI Interface
lede: Impeccable gives frontend agents a compact command set for shaping, critiquing, hardening, and polishing web interfaces. Deterministic detectors catch recurring failures such as weak contrast, generic typography, excessive cards, and brittle responsive layouts before they reach production.

headline: Cindy Puts Practical Agents in Your Hands
lede: Cindy is a locally running agent workspace with access to files, applications, browsers, phones, memory, and automation tools. Its open architecture lets users switch models and harnesses while keeping workflows extensible through skills, plugins, and MCP connections.

headline: OpenBot Keeps AI Teammates on Queue
lede: OpenBot gives persistent agents isolated workspaces, FIFO task queues, shared channels, file transfer, and agent-to-agent messaging. Its desktop-first environment is built for long-running work that continues after the prompt is sent, with local and self-hosted deployment paths for extended control.

headline: Jailbreaks Maps the Model Instruction Surface
lede: Jailbreaks assembles model-specific system prompts, workspace policies, personas, and Ollama Modelfiles for testing how instruction hierarchies alter behavior. For evaluators and defenders, the collection is a practical catalog of prompt injection surfaces, policy overrides, and configuration differences across more than 25 models.
